title: Flagged translation passage outcomes
description: The answers a human reviewer may give on a passage the translation workflow's QA flagged.

source.note: bean bvuk; the owner's own answer set and design, 2026-09-23

codes.label: Accept as-is
codes.definition: The flag was a false positive; the translation stands and the workflow writes an unofficial status.

codes.label: Edit and re-run QA
codes.definition: Correct the passage in place; Task_EditTranslation re-injects it, so QA re-runs over the corrected PO file rather than discarding a good translation wholesale.

codes.label: Reject — re-translate
codes.definition: Reject the translation and request a new one; it goes back to Task_Translate.
